a fiber oscillator is a good candidate for seeding high-power Ti:Sa amplifier systems.
the fiber laser is an attractive alternative to the Ti:Sa laser for seeding multi-terawat amplifiers.

the frequency-doubling of a high-power fiber laser can be used as an alternative seed source for Ti:Sa amplifier systems, which can lead to the development of compact and robust high-energy, few-cycle laser systems.
a frequency-doubler can be used as an alternative to a Ti:Sa oscillator for seeding a multi-terawatts Ti:Sa system, with the advantage of a more robust and compact setup.
